ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, with a picture of grass labeled “Grass” on the right side. A picture of an insect labeled “Grasshopper” is located above and slightly to the left of the grass, and there is an arrow pointing from Grass to Grasshopper. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate that energy or food flows from the food source being eaten to the organism that eats it. Therefore, pointing from Grass to Grasshopper indicates that Grasshopper feeds on grass.
